body: a stylized chibi 3D-render fantasy mage character, standing in a strict neutral T-pose facing the camera dead-on: both arms held straight out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, palms open, legs straight and shoulder-width apart, no staff or weapon in hand, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Same toy-like proportions as a chibi knight companion character, big head small body but noticeably taller and thinner build than a stocky knight, smooth 3D render style, single even studio lighting from the front, plain flat white background, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos
